readOnly.setting: Shown to members (not admins) under a settings card they can read but not change.
permissions.title: Card on the workspace's General settings page: what every socio (AI agent) may do.
permissions.autosave: There is no Save button: each switch saves as soon as it changes.
permissions.research.title: Switch: socios (AI agents) may search the web and read public pages.
permissions.research.saved: Toast after the switch saved. "Turns" are AI agent replies in progress.
permissions.memory.title: Switch: socios (AI agents) may use the memories they saved about people.
permissions.memory.saved: Toast after the switch saved. "Turns" are AI agent replies in progress.
dailyLimits.perDot: Field label: the limit for each socio (AI agent).
dailyLimits.perUser: Field label: the limit for each person.
dailyLimits.invalid: Error under the fields. {{max}} is the largest number allowed.
dailyLimits.dot.title: Card: how much socios (AI agents) may file a day, such as requests for new capabilities and items on the board.
dailyLimits.dot.perDotHint: Hint under the "Per socio" field: the limit counts what one socio (AI agent) files for all of its people.
dailyLimits.dot.perUserHint: Hint under the "Per person" field: the limit counts what all of one person’s socios (AI agents) file.
dailyLimits.dot.saved: Toast after the socio filing limit fields saved.
dailyLimits.notification.title: Card: how many notifications socios (AI agents) may send people a day.
dailyLimits.notification.intro: notify_user is the name of the agents' tool: keep it.
dailyLimits.notification.perDotHint: Hint under the "Per socio" field: notifications from one socio (AI agent) to one person.
dailyLimits.notification.perUserHint: Hint under the "Per person" field: notifications to one person from all of their socios (AI agents).
dailyLimits.notification.saved: Toast after the notification limit fields saved.
backupSchedule.title: Card on the General settings page: how often the server backs up, copies off-site and runs a restore drill. Only admins can change it.
backupSchedule.saved: Toast after the backup schedule fields saved.
backupSchedule.invalid: Error under the backup schedule fields: each variable is a number.
backupSchedule.hours.label: Field label: hours between scheduled backups; the unit is in parentheses.
backupSchedule.seconds.label: The continuous copy is Litestream's copy of the database (Litestream is a product name); its files are sent to off-site storage this often.
backupSchedule.seconds.hint: {{min}} is the fewest seconds allowed. "Sealed": encrypted.
backupSchedule.days.label: Field label: days between restore drills (automatic test restores of the continuous copy); the unit is in parentheses.
backupSchedule.days.hint: "Run drill now" is a button's label on the same page (settings.workspace-setup:drill.run): keep them matching.
backupSchedule.purgeDays.label: A permanent removal deletes data for good; its backup is kept this many days.
branding.title: Card, admins only: the workspace’s own name and logo.
branding.name: Label of the field for the workspace’s name, shown in navigation and on the sign-in page.
branding.namePlaceholder: Example workspace name in an empty field: a company's internal knowledge base.
branding.nameSaved: Toast after the workspace name saved.
branding.logoPreview: Screen reader text of the image that previews the current logo.
branding.logo: Label of a file picker: the logo of the company that runs this workspace.
branding.logoSaved: Toast after a new logo was picked and saved.
branding.useProductLogo: Button: show the product's own logo instead of a custom one.
branding.productLogoSaved: Toast after the button that shows the product’s own logo again instead of a custom one.
branding.useDefaults: Button: go back to the name and logo the server's deployment sets.
branding.defaultsSaved: Toast after "Use deployment defaults": the name and logo the server’s deployment sets are back.
spaces.title: "Space" is a product noun: a shared area for a team's pages and chats. Keep it capitalized if your language allows.
spaces.toggle: Switch on the Spaces card: whether members (not only admins) may create Spaces.
spaces.saved: Toast after the switch saved: who may now create Spaces.
modelFallback.title: Card: what happens when an AI model is too busy to answer right now.
modelFallback.description: ChatGPT is a product name. "Shared model": the model the workspace provides for everyone.
modelFallback.saved: Toast after the switch saved; the _off form is for when it was turned off.
tracing.title: Card: the technical records (traces) each AI agent reply keeps, and whether they include what was written.
tracing.intro: "Runs" is the name of a page listing agent runs. A turn is one AI agent reply.
tracing.notExporting: OpenTelemetry is a product name; OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT is an environment variable: keep them.
tracing.toggle: Switch: exported traces include what people sent, the socio’s (AI agent’s) answers and tool input and output.
tracing.saved: Toast after the switch saved; the _off form is for when it was turned off.
autoTriage.title: Card: the AI model proposes a kind, area, priority and labels for each new issue on the board.
autoTriage.toggle: Switch: the AI model proposes a kind, area, priority and labels for each new issue on the board.
autoTriage.toggled: Toast after the switch saved; the _off form is for when it was turned off.
autoTriage.saved: Toast after the "Most a day" field saved.
autoTriage.invalid: Error under the "Most a day" field. {{max}} is the largest number allowed.
autoTriage.perDay: Field label: the most issues the model is asked about in a day.
context.title: Card: how a chat too long for its AI model is condensed into notes.
context.saved: Toast after a setting on the Long chats card saved.
context.summaryModel: Label of a select: which AI model writes the notes.
context.models.shared: Option of the "Notes are written by" select: the AI model the workspace provides for everyone.
context.models.chat: Option of the "Notes are written by" select: the AI model the chat itself uses.
context.selection: Label of a select: which pinned facts from the notes each reply gets.
context.selections.age: Option of the "Each reply sees" select: the most recently pinned facts.
context.selections.relevance: Option of the "Each reply sees" select: the pinned facts that best match each message.
context.selections.pointer: A short core of the facts goes with each message; the socio searches the notes for the rest.
